procedure: Trace inventory fields to approved system documentation and confirm named accountable owner
expected_evidence: Approved inventory; owner assignment; approval record
sample_or_scope: All in-scope systems and material components
acceptance_criteria: All required fields complete and owner approval independently verifiable
limitation: Fictional system; no owner or deployed system

procedure: Trace each material stakeholder impact to a risk scenario mitigation and accountable decision
expected_evidence: Approved impact assessment; stakeholder analysis; decision log
sample_or_scope: All identified affected groups and use contexts
acceptance_criteria: Material impacts have evidence-linked mitigations and unresolved gaps are escalated
limitation: Current impact assessment is self-authored draft

procedure: Select source fields and trace them through ingestion transformation model input output and retention
expected_evidence: Data dictionary; lineage records; source contracts; access and deletion evidence
sample_or_scope: Representative fields and all high-impact data categories
acceptance_criteria: Every sampled field has attributable source transformation purpose owner and retention rule

procedure: Trace each high-priority risk to treatment owner due date approval and review trigger
expected_evidence: Risk register; treatment plan; risk acceptance record
acceptance_criteria: No material risk lacks owner treatment decision and review trigger
limitation: Risks remain hypotheses; no owner exists

procedure: Walk through seeded correct and incorrect outputs; verify reviewer can inspect source correct override and escalate
expected_evidence: Workflow configuration; reviewer instructions; training; sampled review and override logs
sample_or_scope: At least one case per material error type plus reviewer sample
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer identifies seeded material errors and can change/escalate decisions with traceable records

procedure: Reperform approved test set; stratify extraction and ranking errors; compare to pre-approved thresholds
expected_evidence: Versioned test set; ground-truth protocol; raw outputs; scored results; adjudication
sample_or_scope: Representative cases across formats roles and relevant cohorts
acceptance_criteria: Pre-registered thresholds met and critical errors escalated; no post-hoc threshold changes
limitation: No model test set or threshold exists

procedure: Compare approved notices and user documentation with actual data use outputs and system behavior
expected_evidence: Approved notices; user guide; system card; change history
acceptance_criteria: Documents accurately describe actual use limitations and available challenge/correction routes
limitation: No deployment or legal review exists

procedure: Inspect sampled events for actor timestamp model version input/output reference decision and access controls
expected_evidence: Event schema; access logs; retention configuration; sampled records
sample_or_scope: Sample across normal use exception and override events
acceptance_criteria: Records are complete attributable protected and retained/deleted according to approved policy
limitation: No logging system or event data exists

procedure: Review threat model; inspect access tests; run authorized incident tabletop and track actions
expected_evidence: Threat model; access test evidence; incident playbook; tabletop record
sample_or_scope: Key data flows and critical incident scenarios
acceptance_criteria: No unresolved critical access path; incident roles and containment steps demonstrated
limitation: No technical environment or exercise exists

procedure: Inspect approved metrics thresholds owners alerts and revalidation after a simulated material change
expected_evidence: Metric definitions; monitoring reports; alert records; change tickets
sample_or_scope: All critical metrics and one material change scenario
acceptance_criteria: Threshold breach produces documented escalation pause decision and revalidation
limitation: No telemetry or change records exist
